audit.task_types_changed: task types changed on board {board} ({types} type(s), {count} task(s) moved)

errors.board_holds_tasks: board {board:%q} still holds {count} task(s) — pass ?move_to=<board> to relocate them
errors.board_lacks_type: board {board:%q} does not offer task type {type:%q}
errors.board_left_in_place: {cause} — the board was left in place so no task is stranded on it
errors.board_still_receiving: board {board:%q} keeps receiving tasks while being deleted ({count} still on it) — retry once it is idle
errors.destination_type_skips_stage: task {task} sits in {stage:%q}, which type {type:%q} skips — pick another destination type
errors.invalid_destination_board: move_to {dest:%q} is not a valid destination board
errors.invalid_destination_type: move_to {dest:%q} is not one of the types this board will offer
errors.skip_strands_tasks: {count} task(s) of type {type:%q} sit in {stage:%q}, which this edit would skip — pass ?move_to_stage=<stage> to relocate them
errors.stage_missing_on_board: stage {stage:%q} does not exist on board {board:%q}
errors.type_holds_tasks: task type {type:%q} still holds {count} task(s) — pass ?move_to=<type> to re-type them (empty for untyped)
errors.type_list_unchanged: {cause} — the type list was left unchanged

log.count_by_type: count tasks by type for board {board}
log.seed_default_board: seed the default board of workspace {workspace}
